sources.observation: A shuttered circular window on each side of the open rectangular gate, a red brick wall, grey plinth, raised stairs and green-tiled eaves.
Two decorated roof tiers, a raised stone terrace with a wide central stair, and red timber bays distinguish the main hall.

limitations: The extent, orientation and altitude come from the mapped buildings and Terrarium. Secondary roof profiles, hall heights, terrace levels, signage and stone sculpture are exterior interpretations of reference photographs.
